spec_theorems.name: run_output
spec_theorems.informal: The command writes exactly the adjacent-duplicate-collapsed input lines to standard output.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: Successful execution returns exit code zero.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_membership
spec_theorems.informal: Every output line is an occurrence of a line from the input.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_length_bound
spec_theorems.informal: The number of output lines never exceeds the number of input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_idempotent
spec_theorems.informal: Applying the adjacent-duplicate filter twice produces the same output as applying it once.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_is_input_or_empty
spec_theorems.informal: If the output is nonempty, then the input is nonempty, expressing the basic relation between input and output.
